en: NetEase streams in Hi-Res (24-bit, up to 192 kHz) for the accounts that have it (SVIP), lossless otherwise.

NetEase playlists in the Archive: GROUP › ONLINE puts your liked songs and the playlists you made on shelves of their own, one shelf per playlist, its songs as album cases with their covers (or one case per song under TRACKS, one per playlist under FOLDERS), in ARRAY, ROOM and GRID. A double-click plays them through the 05 ONLINE bridge, VIP-only songs left out for other accounts; the album file lists the songs, tagged LOCKED or VIP · TRIAL. Right-click › Online playlists in the Archive chooses the playlists shown (collected ones too), and Refresh online playlists reads them again. A copy is kept on this computer, so the shelves show at once and stay while offline (OFFLINE COPY); NetEase is asked at most every 30 minutes, one playlist at a time, and only for the playlists that changed. Needs the bridge and a NetEase login in 05 ONLINE.

Edit your NetEase playlists in 05 ONLINE: right-click a song › Add to playlist (your liked songs, a playlist you made, or a new one), or Remove from “…” in one of yours; right-click a playlist to rename or delete one you made, or to collect someone else's.
A slide bar beside 05 ONLINE's long lists (a playlist of thousands of songs, search results, all playlists).
The Archive's GROUP and SORT are menus now, rather than rows of every choice; GROUP › ONLINE stands apart in it, with the playlists shown and Refresh online playlists right there while it is chosen.
Clicking the cover in the bottom bar (or the profile card) while a NetEase song plays now opens its case under GROUP › ONLINE when the song is on a playlist shown there.
Without media library folders, the Archive no longer shows the songs of the playlists 05 ONLINE fills (NetEase · …, QQ Music · …) as nameless cases.

NetEase lossless (FLAC) songs now carry their title, artists, album and cover: the track card, the visualization and the bottom bar show the cover, and the playlist shows the artist (before, only MP3 songs had them). Songs not played yet show their artist and title apart instead of "?".
foobar2000 could crash shortly after a NetEase playlist was started with the playlist view open (its total length was read while the songs were still being added).
A NetEase account that became VIP (or SVIP) after logging in is now seen as one: VIP songs play in full instead of being treated as locked (the account is read again when the bridge starts).
Updating the theme now updates the 05 ONLINE bridge too (it stayed as first installed).

Online lyrics no longer come from another song of the same artist and length: NetEase and the LRCLIB search now also check the title (its aliases and translated names too), so a track found by its file name, with no title tag, gets no lyrics rather than wrong ones. What was found before is looked up again once.

With the theme in Chinese on a Windows in another language, AUTO now asks NetEase when LRCLIB has nothing and the NetEase translation is on, as on a Chinese Windows (settings you already chose are kept).
zh: 网易云串流支持 Hi-Res（24 位，最高 192 kHz），需要账号支持（SVIP），否则为无损。

网易云歌单进入曲库：分组 › 在线 会把你喜欢的音乐和你创建的歌单放进曲库，每个歌单一排，歌曲按专辑做成带封面的唱片盒（选 曲目 时每首歌一个，选 文件夹 时每个歌单一个），陈列、展室和网格都能用。双击即可通过 05 在线的本地服务播放，非 VIP 账号会跳过 VIP 专享的歌曲；专辑资料里列出全部歌曲，并标出 已锁定 或 VIP · 试听。右键 › 曲库中显示的网易云歌单 可以选择显示哪些歌单（收藏的歌单也可以），刷新网易云歌单 会重新读取。歌单会在这台电脑上保存一份副本，打开时立即显示，离线时也还在（离线副本）；最多每 30 分钟向网易云请求一次，一次只读一个歌单，并且只读有变化的歌单。需要先在 05 在线中安装本地服务并登录网易云。
在 05 在线中编辑网易云歌单：右键歌曲 › 加入歌单（我喜欢的音乐、你创建的歌单或新建一个），在你自己的歌单里可以 从「…」中移除；右键歌单可以重命名或删除你创建的歌单，或收藏别人的歌单。
在 05 在线中，长列表（几千首歌的歌单、搜索结果、全部歌单）右侧加了可拖动的滑动条。
曲库顶栏的 分组 和 排序 改成下拉菜单，不再把所有选项排成一行；分组 菜单里 在线 单独分开，选中时菜单里直接就有显示哪些歌单和 刷新网易云歌单。
播放网易云歌曲时点击底栏封面（或信息卡），如果这首歌在曲库显示的歌单里，现在会切到 分组 › 在线 并打开它的唱片盒。
没有设置媒体库文件夹时，曲库不会再把 05 在线填充的播放列表（NetEase · …、QQ Music · …）里的歌曲显示成没有名字的唱片盒。
网易云无损（FLAC）歌曲现在也带有标题、艺人、专辑和封面：曲目信息卡、可视化和底栏都能显示封面，播放列表能显示艺人（以前只有 MP3 歌曲有）。还没播放过的歌曲也会分开显示艺人和歌名，不再是「?」。
播放网易云歌单后立即打开播放列表视图时，foobar2000 可能崩溃（歌曲还在加入时读取了总时长），已修复。
登录后才开通 VIP（或 SVIP）的网易云账号现在会被正确识别：VIP 歌曲可以完整播放，不再被当作锁定（本地服务启动时会重新读取账号信息）。
更新主题时，05 在线的本地服务也会一起更新（以前一直停留在首次安装的版本）。
在线歌词不会再取到同一艺人、时长相近的另一首歌：网易云和 LRCLIB 搜索现在也会核对歌名（包括别名和译名），没有标题标签、只能按文件名查找的曲目宁可不显示歌词，也不会显示错的。之前缓存的结果会重新查找一次。
界面设为中文而 Windows 是其他语言时，歌词来源 自动 现在也会在 LRCLIB 找不到时查找网易云，并默认开启网易云翻译，与中文 Windows 一致（已经手动设置过的不受影响）。
